notes: Ket hop ca 3 huong cho danh sach goi y giao dich trong ngay: (1) loc theo dung target toi thieu (mac dinh 2%, tuy chinh duoc), (2) quet dong thoi 3 khung 15m/1h/4h cho moi coin thay vi 1 khung, lay ket qua tot nhat, (3) hang 'Kha' (diem 2.5-3.5) hien rieng biet, minh bach, khong an. Them tong hop cac lenh dang mo (tong von, tong lai/lo, %). Da kiem chung bang render test that.
